## 8b45d6dd2123

**Reproduced exact-control defect.** Generator SHA-256
`ffd54c7424ca1bcb49a234e5998f5aec2b29414fc9665a605ffdaa39eb6ad767`,
executed rule hash `14d8eb38a88f`.

The generator advertises `n_distinct_colors` as an exact integer axis but never
consumes it. With seed `0`, sample index `0`, difficulty `easy`, overrides
`n_distinct_colors=1` and `n_distinct_colors=9` return the identical lawful grid
(input hash identical) containing three nonzero colors; `self_check` returns no
errors. The module also has no `observe_overrides`, and several other advertised
axes (`palette_kind`, fixed `position_bias`, fixed `density`, and helpful texture
aliases) are not consumed by generation.

The canonical Racket transformation itself returned a valid palette `[6,4,1]`;
this finding concerns the generator's advertised control surface, not rule
semantics. Exact calls, input, counts, Racket output, hashes, and command are in
`checks/audit/8b45d6dd2123/analysis.json`. No audit-target files were changed.
